current_grouping: Subpart J — Auxiliary Power Unit Installations

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart J — Auxiliary Power Unit Installations
versions.text:
(a) Each oil shut-off must meet the requirements of CS 25J1189.
(b) Each oil valve must have positive stops or suitable index provisions in the "on'' and "off'' positions and must be supported so that no loads resulting from its operation or from accelerated flight conditions are transmitted to the lines attached to the valve, unless adequate strength margins under all loading conditions are provided in the lines and connections.
